summary: Iteration 28 — End-to-end test of the Skali feed/messages/find/settings/profile UI rearrangement at mobile 390x860. Backend (5/5 passed): GET /api/streamers returns {live, creators} with tester present in creators; GET /api/unread includes 'activity' key; POST /api/live/start with kind='stream' as viewer → 403 (gated); POST /api/live/start with kind='story' as viewer → 500 'LiveKit is not configured' (gate passed, expected); GET /api/interests works. Frontend (all acceptance criteria met): Feed has NO inline composer, feed-pinned-header + feed-scroll present, tabs General/Following/Interests (testids feed-tab-general, feed-tab-followers, feed-tab-interests — note Following testid is 'feed-tab-followers'), StoryRail inside pinned header. Bottom nav shows exactly feed/find/create/messages/me (no activity). bottom-nav-create opens create-sheet with create-sheet-post + create-sheet-live-story; create-sheet-post opens composer-sheet with audience tiers (Public/Followers/Inner Circle), composer-text, composer-submit, tag input, photo/mic buttons. Messages has messages-activity-pill (unread badge 1 shown) → navigates to /activity; activity-back returns to /messages. Find Discover empty by default. Find Streamers tab (find-tab-streamers) shows streamers-search-input and tester visible in ALL CREATORS. Settings → Preferences → preferences-tab-interests renders InterestsManager. Profile for viewer (/u/viewer): no 'SKALI PRESENTS' text, profile-flyer-title = '#viewer', no creator-studio-live. Profile for tester (/u/thisismajorofficial): profile-flyer-title = '#thisismajorofficial', creator-studio-live visible labelled 'Content Streaming'. Story rail watch-live-btn labelled 'Watch Streams' navigates to /search?tab=streamers. add-story-btn (viewer with no story) opens story-chooser with story-chooser-media + story-chooser-live. Avatar menu: post-avatar-{id} on tester's post opens avatar-menu-sheet with avatar-menu-view-profile + avatar-menu-view-story (tester has active story). thread-avatar-{handle} on Messages list opens avatar-menu-sheet without navigating into chat. Login via email/password form works for both accounts. No console errors beyond expected React Router v7 future-flag warnings and WebSocket ws/user transient close.

issues: Display name below the handle ('THISISMAJORLYLONGNAMEFORTESTING') wraps to 2 lines on 390px viewport for the long-handle creator account — review request says it should 'shrink to fit one line'. The handle (#thisismajorofficial / profile-flyer-title) itself fits one line fine; it's the display_name underneath that overflows.

action_items: Consider renaming data-testid 'feed-tab-followers' → 'feed-tab-following' to match the review request's testid name (label 'Following' is already correct). Not a functional bug.
On Profile header, auto-shrink/truncate the long display_name under the handle so it stays on one line on 390px viewport (currently wraps for 'THISISMAJORLYLONGNAMEFORTESTING').

AvatarMenu's click handler ignores Playwright force=True clicks because the span has stopPropagation+preventDefault called synchronously after setOpen; functionally fine for real users (normal clicks + keyboard work), but worth noting for future automation harnesses.
critical_code_review_comments: FEED_TABS key for Following is 'followers' which produces data-testid='feed-tab-followers' — mismatches the plan's 'feed-tab-following'. Minor but affects test selectors.
AvatarMenu: `storiesOfUser` is called every tap with no caching; could spam /api/stories/u/:handle on repeated taps. Low priority.

PostCard author display_name link `<Link to={/u/${a.handle}}>` still exists next to AvatarMenu, so tapping the name navigates while tapping the avatar opens the sheet — behaviour matches review intent but double-check UX wants the whole header-row to open the sheet instead.
test_credentials: tester@skali.test / Test1234! (creator, handle #thisismajorofficial); viewer@skali.test / Test1234! (viewer, handle #viewer). Login response field is 'access_token', stored as localStorage.cc_token.
seed_data_creation: None. Did not post any new content or follow/unfollow interests persistently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI rearrangement acceptance criteria pass. Known preview-env limits: LiveKit → /api/live/start returns 500 after gate passes (expected); Supabase storage disabled so uploaded media/VODs stay blank. For avatar-menu Playwright tests, use normal click() NOT force=True — the AvatarMenu span calls preventDefault/stopPropagation on React synthetic event, which force=True bypasses in a way that skips the handler. feed-tab-followers (not feed-tab-following) is the actual testid for the 'Following' tab.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Earlier false-positive 'avatar-menu-sheet not opening on post-avatar click' was a test-harness artefact: Playwright click(force=True) on the AvatarMenu <span> did not fire the React onClick on this build; normal click() and element.click() both open the sheet correctly. Verified visually in screenshot.
